messages.content: A student is solving 3(x - 4) + 5 = 20 and is stuck. Give one hint, explain why it is valid, ask one check question, and do not reveal x.
A 2 kg object has net force 10 N. Student writes F=ma; 10=2a; a=20. Identify the exact mistake, explain why, give a corrective hint, ask one follow-up. Do not give the final acceleration.
Explain how a dam makes electricity for a 15-year-old: sequence stored water to generator, distinguish energy/force/power, African-context analogy, one misconception, two check questions.
A ball thrown straight up: at the top is velocity zero, acceleration zero, both, or neither? Explain for Grade 10 with one everyday example.
Derive the quadratic formula by completing the square for ax^2+bx+c=0. Explain each step. No GSM8K markup.
For CH4+2O2->CO2+2H2O, 16 g CH4 and 48 g O2: limiting reactant and mass of CO2 produced?

Student work for 3(x-2)=2x+5:
Line1: 3x-2=2x+5
Line2: 3x-2x=5+2
Line3: x=7
Which line has the first mistake and what went wrong? Do not solve it fully.
Stuck on 2x+7=19. One hint with why and a check question; do not give x.
